lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes Teams.  
  
You need to ensure that only existing guest user accounts can access Teams files. New guest users must be restricted from accessing files in Teams.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Teams admin center, configure the Guest access settings.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, configure the External access settings.
From the SharePoint admin center, configure the Sharing settings.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure the External collaboration settings.

questions.explanation: SharePoint Sharing settings control file access for guest users. To restrict file access to existing guests only and prevent new guests from accessing files, adjust the sharing settings in the SharePoint admin center to 'existing guests.' Teams and Entra external settings control guest invitations and collaboration policies but do not directly restrict file access by guest account status.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
From the chat window of a Teams chat, you share a file with a user named User.  
  
User1 reports that when they attempt to open the file in Teams, they receive the following message:  
  
“You don’t have access to this file.”  
  
You need to ensure that User1 can open the file.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Teams settings in the Microsoft Teams admin center, configure the file storage and sharing options.
From the SharePoint admin center, configure the Sharing settings.
From Microsoft OneDrive, set Limited-access user permission lockdown mode to Deactivate.
From the SharePoint admin center, configure the Access control settings.

questions.explanation:
A file shared in a Teams chat is stored in the sender's OneDrive, and "You don't have access to this file" is the documented symptom of the Limited-access user permission lockdown mode feature being turned on for that OneDrive site. Microsoft's fix is to deactivate that setting directly on the OneDrive site (it's not recommended for OneDrive sites), rather than adjust tenant-wide SharePoint sharing, access-control, or Teams file-storage settings.

**Learn more:** [Error when opening a file in Teams: You don't have access to this file](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/troubleshoot/files/do-not-have-access-to-this-file-teams)

questions.question:
You have a Teams deployment.  
  
You deploy the new Teams client to users.  
  
Some users report that the Teams Meeting add-in is missing from Microsoft Outlook after the deployment.  
  
You need to ensure that Outlook has the Teams Meeting add-in.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Uninstall the Teams Meeting add-in and restart Teams and Outlook.
Run the Teams client as an administrator.

questions.explanation: When the Teams Meeting add-in is missing after deploying the new Teams client, uninstalling the add-in and restarting both Teams and Outlook allows the system to reinstall it correctly. This resolves compatibility issues between the new Teams client and Outlook.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling

options.text: From PowerShell, run the Update-csTenantMeetingUrl cmdlet.
From the Azure Active Directory admin center, modify the Usage location of User1.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, modify the Users settings of User1.
From PowerShell, run the Start-CsEXMeetingMigration cmdlet.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, modify the default Bridge settings.

questions.explanation: To change a specific user's conferencing toll number while keeping it unavailable for other users, modify that user's settings in the Microsoft Teams admin center (step C), then run Start-CsEXMeetingMigration (step D) to update all existing meeting invites with the new toll number. This two-step approach ensures only that user's meetings are affected while preserving the default number for others.

Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. All users have Windows 10 computers that are joined to Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and enrolled in Microsoft Intune. All users are standard users.  
  
The company plans to start using Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to deploy the Microsoft Teams client to the computers.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Because the devices are Azure AD-joined and enrolled in Microsoft Intune, and the users are standard users without local admin rights, the supported way to push required software to them is through Intune app deployment (adding Microsoft Teams as a Windows app/Line-of-Business app assigned as "Required" to the device or user groups). Domain-based GPOs cannot apply to Azure AD-joined devices since there is no on-premises Active Directory domain association, Azure AD app registrations are used for application identity and API permissions rather than software installation, and Azure App Service is a cloud hosting platform for web apps, not a client deployment mechanism.

**Learn more:** [Add apps to Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/mem/intune/apps/apps-add) · [Deploy Microsoft Teams using Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/msi-deployment)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that contains two users named User1 and User2. The users are provisioned for Microsoft Teams calling.  

User1 is on leave for two weeks.  

You need to ensure that User2 is notified of all calls to User1 while User1 is away.  

Which two actions should you perform? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: From Voice, add User2 to group call pickup.
From Voice, add User1 to group call pickup.
From Policies, modify the voice routing policy.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, modify the settings of User2.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, modify the settings of User1.

questions.explanation:
To have User2 notified of calls placed to User1, an admin edits User1's Voice call answering settings in the Teams admin center to route calls through a call group (group call pickup) rather than only a personal forward, and then adds User2 to that group call pickup so User2's client also rings when User1 is called. Modifying User2's settings or the voice routing policy does not target incoming calls to User1's number.
**Learn more:** [Call sharing and group call pickup](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/call-sharing-and-group-call-pickup)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that contains 300 users.  
  
All the users have existing direct inward dial (DID) phone numbers.  
  
You plan to implement Phone System in Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to migrate the users' DID phone numbers to Microsoft Teams.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From Voice in the Microsoft Teams admin center, select Phone numbers, and then select Add.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, run the porting wizard.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, create a dial plan.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, open a service request.

questions.explanation: The porting wizard in the Microsoft Teams admin center is the designated tool for migrating existing Direct Inward Dial (DID) phone numbers from current carriers to Microsoft Teams. This wizard guides administrators through the number porting process, which is a carrier-managed procedure. It is the proper first step to transition users' DID numbers to Phone System.

You need to identify the following information for each team:  
  
• The number of standard, private, and shared channels  

• The number of team members  

• The number of guests  
  
The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you use in the Microsoft Teams admin center?
questions.explanation: The Manage teams grid in the Teams admin center (Teams > Manage teams) displays, for every team in a single sortable list, columns for standard channels, private channels, shared channels, team members, and guests, letting an admin gather all of this data for 25 teams without opening each team individually. Teams advisor is used for network planning, Usage reports provide tenant-wide activity metrics rather than a channel-type breakdown, and Reporting labels categorize call quality data, none of which meet the requirement with minimal effort. **Learn more:** [Manage teams in the Microsoft Teams admin center](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/manage-teams-in-modern-portal)

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365. All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

All users use Microsoft Teams for collaboration.  

Users in the Marketing department often host live events in Microsoft Teams for large audiences.  

Users report that Internet performance is poor during the live events. You discover that the live events consume a large amount of Internet bandwidth.  

You need to reduce the Internet bandwidth consumed during the live events.  

Which of the following should you configure?

options.text: An Enterprise Content Delivery Network (eCDN) provider.

questions.explanation: Enterprise Content Delivery Network (eCDN) optimizes bandwidth consumption for live video streaming within enterprise networks. By distributing video content locally rather than streaming everything from a central source, eCDN significantly reduces Internet bandwidth usage during large-scale live events.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams. The subscription contains 1,000 users in the groups shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783720562693-kt0dic8d.png)  
  
You need to configure Microsoft Teams to meet the requirements. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  

What should you use?
questions.explanation: Policy packages are collections of predefined policies bundled together for user roles with similar collaboration needs. The table shows Group1 requires full access and Group2 requires restricted access with specific configurations. Policy packages minimize administrative effort by applying multiple coordinated policies simultaneously to user groups, rather than configuring each policy individually. This is the most efficient solution for managing 1,000 users across different departments with distinct requirements.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization has a Microsoft Office 365 subscription. The organization has the departments and teams shown in the table below.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783720219762-psyhklx3.png)  
  
You need to make sure that only the following apps show up in the app bar of the Microsoft Teams client, and only for the Events department:  
  
- Activity  
- Shifts  
- Chat  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Create a custom app permission policy.
Modify the global app permission policy.
Create a custom app setup policy.
Modify the global app setup policy.

questions.explanation:
App setup policies determine which apps are pinned to the Teams app bar and in what order, whereas app permission policies control whether an app is allowed or blocked for use — not the app bar layout. Because the pinned-app restriction must apply only to the Events team and not to every user in the organization (HR and R&D must be unaffected), editing the Global (Org-wide default) app setup policy is not appropriate, since that would change the app bar for all users. Instead, a new custom app setup policy must be created with only Activity, Shifts, and Chat added under Pinned apps; this custom policy can then be assigned specifically to the Events team/group, overriding the Global policy for just those users while leaving everyone else on the default configuration.

**Learn more:** [Manage agents and app setup policies in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-app-setup-policies) · [Overview of app policies to manage apps in Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/app-policies)

You plan to implement Teams.  
  
You need to confirm the location of the Teams service workload for data at rest.  
  
What should you configure in the Microsoft 365 admin center?

options.text: the Data sources tab in Search & intelligence
the Organization profile tab in Org settings

questions.explanation: To view the data location for Teams service workload at rest, navigate to the Microsoft 365 admin center, then Settings > Org settings > Organization profile > Data location. This section displays where Teams data is stored geographically for compliance and residency verification.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
You need to upload network IP subnet information to call analytics.  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
Reporting labels let an admin upload a text file mapping IP subnets to physical location names (building, city, etc.), and that mapping is used by Call Analytics to display friendly location names in individual call reports. Network topology instead feeds the Call Quality Dashboard, voice application policies govern call routing features like auto attendants, and Notification & alerts configures device health alerting, not subnet-to-location mapping for Call Analytics.\
**Learn more:** [Add and update reporting labels](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/learn-more-about-site-upload)

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
You need to upload network IP subnet information to call analytics.  
  
What should you configure?

options.text: Modify the caller ID properties of User5.
Assign a Phone System license to User5.
Assign a SIP address to User5.
Assign an app setup policy to User5.

questions.explanation:
The Teams dial pad is only displayed for users who are licensed for and enabled for Phone System (Enterprise Voice) calling. Since other users in the tenant can already make calls, the underlying Phone System capability is available organization-wide, but User5 specifically is missing the individual prerequisites: a Phone System license assignment and Enterprise Voice enablement on the account. Both must be configured for the dial pad and calling functionality to appear for that user. Caller ID configuration, SIP address assignment, and app setup policies do not control dial pad visibility or calling eligibility.

**Learn more:** [Set up Phone System - Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/setting-up-your-phone-system) · [Manage Calling Policies in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-calling-policy)

questions.question:
You need to troubleshoot the user-reported issues.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: the System log in Event Viewer
the Application log in Event Viewer

questions.explanation:
WebRTC logs capture browser-based real-time audio and video connection details, making them the appropriate diagnostic data for Teams meeting media issues experienced in a web browser.\
\
**Learn more:** [Browser logs and tracing for Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/browser-logs-and-tracing-for-teams)

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
You need to troubleshoot the user-reported issues.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
Reviewing call quality metrics for all users in Call Quality Dashboard (CQD) requires access to end-user identifiable information (EUII), since without EUII the reports cannot be tied to specific users. According to Microsoft's documented CQD role permissions, Teams Communications Support Specialist can view CQD reports but is explicitly denied EUII visibility, so it cannot show which specific users are experiencing poor call quality. Teams Administrator and Teams Communications Administrator can both view EUII, but they also carry broad, unrelated administrative permissions (managing meetings, voice, messaging, org-wide settings, etc.), which exceeds what is needed for this task and violates least privilege. The Teams Communications Support Engineer role can view CQD reports with full EUII access (letting Admin5 see call quality data down to the specific impacted users) while lacking the broader administrative capabilities (such as activating CQD, uploading building data, or managing the wider Teams service), making it the most restricted role that still satisfies the requirement.

**Learn more:** [Call Quality Dashboard (CQD) setup - Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/turning-on-and-using-call-quality-dashboard) · [Call Quality Dashboard (CQD) Frequently asked questions (FAQ) - Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/cqd-frequently-asked-questions)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams and contains a user named User.  

You need to ensure that User1 can investigate call-quality issues and identify the following types of information:  
  
Caller and recipient names -  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783720972124-c34cf7g0.png)  
  
✑ Device names and IP addresses  

✑ The number and names of all meeting participants  

The solution must use the principle of least privilege.  

Which role should you assign to User1?
questions.explanation: Assign the Teams communication support engineer role to User1. This role provides access to call quality investigation tools and can view caller/recipient names, device names and IP addresses, and participant information in the Call Quality Dashboard and Call Analytics, while maintaining the principle of least privilege by limiting access to investigation functions only.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams and contains the resources shown in the following table.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783721403602-6ldrdb5t.png)  
  
You need to configure the subscription to meet the following requirements:  
  
• App1 must be pinned only to the Teams desktop client of the users in Group1.  

• App2 must be pinned only to the Teams desktop client of the users in Group2.  
  
What should you do in the Microsoft Teams admin center?

options.text: Modify the global (Org-wide default) app permission policy.
Modify the global (Org-wide default) app setup policy.

questions.explanation: Pinning specific apps for specific groups of users on the Teams desktop client requires creating separate app setup policies (one that pins App1 for Group1 and another that pins App2 for Group2) and assigning each policy to its respective group. App permission policies control which apps are allowed, not which apps are pinned, and modifying the global policy would apply the same pinned apps to everyone rather than to each group individually.

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription. You have enabled guest access for Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to prevent all users from downloading and opening files that contain malware when using Microsoft Teams channels.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: From the Microsoft 365 Compliance admin center, create a data loss prevention (DLP) policy.
From the Azure Active Directory admin center, enable the End user protection baseline policy.
From the Microsoft 365 Compliance admin center, select Turn on Defender for Office 365 for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams.
From the Azure Active Directory admin center, add an identity provider.

questions.explanation:
Malware protection for files shared in Teams channels (which are backed by SharePoint document libraries) is provided by Safe Attachments in Microsoft Defender for Office 365. Before you can configure a Safe Attachments policy to block malicious files, you must first enable the feature by turning on Defender for Office 365 protection for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams in the Microsoft 365 Defender (Compliance) admin center. This step activates malware scanning for files stored and shared in these services, including Teams channel files.

**Learn more:** [Turn on Safe Attachments for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/security/office-365-security/safe-attachments-for-spo-odfb-teams-about?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams.  

You plan to implement Microsoft Teams Rooms. The solution must meet the following requirements:  

✑ Support Microsoft Teams Rooms, Microsoft Surface Hub, and collaboration bars for Microsoft Teams.  

✑ Ensure that Microsoft manages firmware and application updates for room systems and peripherals.  

✑ Ensure that Microsoft monitors and troubleshoots room system and peripherals.  

Which license should you purchase?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Teams Rooms Premium license includes managed services where Microsoft handles firmware and application updates for room systems and peripherals, and provides monitoring and troubleshooting support. Standard/Basic licenses do not include these managed services. This is the license tier that enables Microsoft to assume responsibility for system management and support.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Users report poor quality during Microsoft Teams audio conferences.  

You run a network trace during an audio conference from a user's device as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783717170582-m1rf9d6j.png)  
  
What causes the poor quality of the audio conferences?

options.text: The source port range for audio is too narrow.
The source port for audio is above 50,000.
The UDP traffic is being limited.
The TLS traffic is being limited.

questions.explanation:
Teams media prefers UDP for real-time audio, but the trace shows TCP traffic (sequence numbers and ACKs) destined for port 443, indicating the client fell back to TCP because UDP media ports were being blocked or throttled on the network. TCP's ordered, retransmission-based delivery is unsuited to real-time audio and produces the jitter and quality issues reported.

**Learn more:** [Teams call quality troubleshooting](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/quality-of-experience-review-guide)

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E3 subscription.  
  
You have a conference room that contains a Teams Rooms device named Device1. Device1 is assigned a Teams Rooms Basic license.  
  
You need to ensure that you can restart Device1 from a remote location.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Assign Device1 a Teams Rooms Pro license.
Assign Device1 a Microsoft 365 E5 license.

questions.explanation: Teams Rooms Pro license is required to enable remote device management capabilities such as restarting a Teams Rooms device from a remote location. The Basic license only provides local management and meeting functionality. Microsoft 365 E5, Intune enrollment, or Entra join alone do not provide remote Teams Rooms management.

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment

options.text: Enable the Anonymous users can join a meeting in the Meeting settings.
Configure the Automatically admit users to Everyone setting in the global meeting policy.
Enable the Allow guest access in Teams in the Org-wide settings.
Configure the Automatically admit users to Everyone in your organization setting in the global meeting policy.

questions.explanation: Anonymous users can join Teams meetings without guest accounts when administrators enable the 'Anonymous users can join a meeting' setting in the meeting settings. This allows external users without Microsoft accounts or organizational membership to attend meetings via direct meeting links.

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  

You plan to implement Microsoft Teams.  

You need to perform network quality and connectivity tests from an on-premises network to Microsoft 365 Online services by using the Network Testing  

Companion.  

You install the Network Testing Companion module on a local Windows 10 device.  

Which additional software should you install to perform the tests?
questions.explanation:
The Network Testing Companion is a PowerShell-based GUI wrapper around Microsoft's Network Assessment Tool; the assessment tool itself must be installed separately (or downloaded automatically by the companion module) to actually execute the connectivity and quality tests against Microsoft 365 online services. Windows Performance Analyzer and Windows Assessment Toolkit are unrelated general-purpose Windows diagnostic tools, not part of this workflow.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Teams Network Assessment Tool](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=103017)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft Office 365 subscription.  

You plan to upgrade from Microsoft Skype for Business to Microsoft Teams.  

You use the following workloads in Skype for Business:  

✑ Audio/video conferencing  

✑ Dial-in conferencing  

✑ Enterprise Voice  

✑ Persistent Chat  

✑ Chat  

You need to ensure that users can evaluate Microsoft Teams while maintaining PSTN calling by using the Skype for Business client.  

Which coexistence mode should you use?

options.text: Skype for Business with Teams collaboration

questions.explanation:
Meetings First (Skype for Business with Teams Collaboration and Meetings) is the coexistence mode designed for organizations with significant on-premises Skype for Business assets and a complex Enterprise Voice deployment that still want users to evaluate Teams quickly: meeting scheduling and conducting moves to Teams while private chat and PSTN calling remain on the Skype for Business client. Islands mode lets both clients run independently but does not specifically preserve PSTN calling on the Skype for Business client as the defined behavior the way Meetings First does.

**Learn more:** [Choose your upgrade journey from Skype for Business to Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/upgrade-and-coexistence-of-skypeforbusiness-and-teams)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription along with an on-premises Active Directory domain that is synchronized using Azure AD Connect.  
  
You need to change the **Membership type** of a group from **Assigned (static)** to **Dynamic User**.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: the Azure Active Directory admin center

questions.explanation:
Changing a group's Membership type to Dynamic User is an Azure AD group property that requires configuring a dynamic membership rule, which is only available through the Azure Active Directory admin center (Groups > group > Properties > Membership type). This feature requires an Azure AD Premium P1 or higher license and applies to cloud-managed Azure AD groups, not on-premises AD groups managed via Active Directory Users and Computers, nor is it configurable from the Microsoft Teams client or Teams admin center.

**Learn more:** [Create or update a dynamic group in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/users/groups-create-rule)

Get-AzureADMSDeletedGroup -SearchString "Team1" retrieves the soft-deleted group object matching the display name "Team1" from the recycle bin (available within 30 days of deletion). The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365. All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E5 license.  

You have configured a Team for each of the departments.  

You need to ensure that you are notified if a user creates a new Team by using the Create a Team option in the Microsoft Teams client.  

Which of the following actions should you perform?

options.text: Configure the External Collaboration settings in the Azure Active Directory admin center.
Configure a supervision policy in the Security & Compliance admin center.
Configure an eDiscovery Case in the Security & Compliance admin center.
Configure an alert policy in the Security & Compliance admin center.

questions.explanation: Alert policies in the Security & Compliance admin center trigger notifications when specific events occur, such as team creation. External Collaboration settings, Supervision policies, and eDiscovery are designed for different compliance and security purposes.

Your company has a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
When users make voice calls from Microsoft Teams, they report poor call quality at specific times of the day.  
  
You need to verify whether Quality of Service (QoS) is being applied to the calls.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
The Network Testing Companion is a Microsoft-provided tool specifically built to validate Teams network readiness, including a QoS validation test that confirms whether QoS (DSCP) markings are being correctly applied to real-time Teams media traffic such as audio, video, and screen sharing across the required ports. This makes it the appropriate tool for confirming whether QoS is actually functioning for Teams calls, as opposed to the Call Quality Dashboard, which reports on call quality metrics after the fact but does not test or confirm QoS tagging, or the Teams client and Network Monitor, which are not designed for this purpose.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Teams Network Assessment Tool - Microsoft Download Center](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=103017) · [Plan and configure network settings for Microsoft Teams - Microsoft Learn Training](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/plan-configure-network-settings-for-microsoft-teams/)

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that includes Teams. The subscription contains a user named User1 that is an owner of a team named Team1. Team1 contains members that include guest user accounts.  
  
You need to ensure that User1 provides a quarterly confirmation for all the guest users that have a legitimate business need for membership to Team1.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Teams admin center, configure the External access settings.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure the External collaboration settings.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, configure the Guest access settings.
From the Microsoft Entra admin center, configure the Access reviews settings.

questions.explanation: Access reviews in Microsoft Entra ID enable team owners to periodically review and confirm that guest users still have a legitimate business need for team membership. Access reviews can be scheduled quarterly and automatically enforce removal of users who are not approved, making this the correct tool for ongoing access verification of guest users.

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Teams deployment.  
  
You need to ensure that a user named User1 can perform the following tasks from the Call Quality Dashboard (CQD):  
  
• Create new Microsoft Power BI reports that contain CQD data.  

• View the IP addresses and MAC addresses of users.  

• Upload office location details, including IP ranges.  
  
The solution must follow the principle of least privilege.  
  
Which role should you assign to User1?
questions.explanation: The Teams Communications Administrator role has permissions to create and edit Power BI reports with Call Quality Dashboard data, view IP and MAC addresses of users, and upload office location details including IP ranges. Teams Communications Support Engineer cannot upload location data; Support Specialist cannot view IP/MAC addresses; Device Administrator and Telephony Administrator lack these CQD permissions.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and use Microsoft Teams.  
  
A user named User1 reports that Microsoft Teams Meeting Add-in for Microsoft Outlook is unavailable and cannot be installed.  
  
You need to ensure that the add-in can be installed.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Clear the Teams client cache of User1.
Instruct User1 to update to the most recent version of the Teams client.

questions.explanation: The Teams Meeting Add-in for Outlook is installed as part of the Teams desktop client. If the add-in is missing or cannot be installed, updating the Teams client to the latest version ensures the add-in is deployed correctly and maintains compatibility with the installed Outlook version.

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has recently purchased a subscription to Microsoft 365.  

All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

You are in the process of configuring Microsoft Teams.  

You need to configure Microsoft Teams to ensure that users within your company can collaborate with users in a partner company. You plan to create guest accounts for users in the partner company.  

Users with Guest accounts must not be able to invite other guests.  

Only users in the partner company must be able to collaborate with your users by using Microsoft Teams.  

Which of the following should you configure?

options.text: The external sharing settings in the SharePoint Admin Center.
The external collaboration settings in Azure Active Directory.
The Anonymous users can join a meeting setting the in the Teams Meeting Settings.
The Global Meeting Policy in the Teams Admin Center.

questions.explanation: External collaboration settings in Azure Active Directory (now Entra ID) control whether external users can invite other external users. This is where guest invitation permissions are managed to restrict contractors from inviting additional guests while allowing your organization to collaborate with partner companies.

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to identify which percentage of meetings include video.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation: Productivity Score Meetings insights (accessible in the Adoption Score section of Microsoft 365 admin center) provides analytics on meeting quality metrics, including the percentage of meetings that include video. This tool aggregates meeting behavior data and displays adoption metrics for meeting best practices, allowing identification of video usage trends across your organization.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
You need to identify the percentage of meetings that follow one or more meeting best practices.  
  
What should you use?

options.text: Adoption Score in the Microsoft 365 admin center
usage reports in the Microsoft Teams admin center
audit reports in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal

questions.explanation: Adoption Score (formerly Productivity Score) in the Microsoft 365 admin center provides analytics on meeting best practices adoption, including the percentage of meetings using video, presenter notes, and other productivity features. This tool specifically measures organization-wide compliance with recommended practices, making it ideal for identifying adoption rates of meeting best practices across your tenant.

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has three divisions. Each division has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription and its own Microsoft Entra ID instance. All the divisions use Teams for collaboration and communication.  
  
You need to recommend a seamless collaboration solution between all the divisions. The solution must support the following:  
  
• Search for users  

• Free/busy status for Teams meetings  

• Collaboration on files stored in Teams  
  
What should you include in the recommendation?
questions.explanation: A multitenant organization in Microsoft Entra ID enables seamless collaboration between multiple organizations with separate Entra ID instances. This supports user search across tenants, free/busy calendar status visibility for Teams meetings, and SharePoint file collaboration without requiring guest access. Shared channels and external access create more restricted collaboration models; guest access requires individual invitations and external user accounts.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365. All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

Most users currently use Microsoft Teams for collaboration. However, several users still use Microsoft Skype for Business Online for collaboration.  

You plan to migrate all users to Microsoft Teams.  

You need to configure the environment to ensure that Microsoft Teams is downloaded and installed in the background for all Microsoft Skype for Business users.  

Which of the following actions should you perform?

options.text: Configure the Teams upgrade settings in the Microsoft Teams admin center.
Configure the External access settings in the Microsoft Teams admin center.
Configure an App Setup policy in the Microsoft Teams admin center.
Configure an App Permission policy in the Microsoft Teams admin center.

questions.explanation: The Teams upgrade settings in the Microsoft Teams admin center include options to download the Teams app in the background for Skype for Business users during migration. This silent installation occurs without user intervention and facilitates smooth transition to Teams.

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are a Systems Administrator for your company. The network contains an Active Directory domain and 200 client computers running Windows 10. All client computers are joined to the on-premises Active Directory domain and are also registered with Azure Active Directory.  
  
The company has a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes Microsoft Intune, and all client computers are enrolled in Microsoft Intune.  
  
You need to deploy the Microsoft Teams client to the client computers.  
  
Which two of the following deployment methods could you use? (Choose two.)

options.text: Configure a Conditional Access policy in Azure Active Directory.
Configure an app in Microsoft Intune.
Configure an Active Directory Group Policy Object (GPO).
Configure an app registration in Azure Active Directory.
Configure a Collection in Azure Active Directory.

questions.explanation:
Because the computers are enrolled in Microsoft Intune, Teams can be packaged and deployed as a Win32 app (or added as a required Store app) through Intune app management. Because the computers are also joined to the on-premises Active Directory domain, a Group Policy Object can be used to deploy the Teams MSI package via computer/user software installation policy. Conditional Access policies only enforce access controls and cannot install software; an Azure AD app registration is used to register an application's identity for authentication/authorization (OAuth/OpenID Connect), not to push software to devices; and 'Collections' are an SCCM/Configuration Manager concept, not a feature of Azure Active Directory, so it is not a valid option here.

**Learn more:** [Deploy the Teams desktop app with Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/msi-deployment) · [Group Policy Software Installation overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/msi/group-policy-software-installation)

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps

options.text: Team type must be set to Private.
The team picture must be the department logo.
The Owner role for a team must be assigned to the department manager of the user that created the team.
The team name must be validated against a blocklist of team names.

questions.explanation: Team templates can preconfigure the team type setting to Private by default. Templates allow administrators to standardize initial team settings including privacy level, channels, and apps, but other governance requirements like name validation, image assignment, and role assignment require additional policies or automation.

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
Solution: In **Connectivity Tests** in Microsoft Remote Connectivity Analyzer, select **Microsoft Teams**.  
  
Does this fulfill the goal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Remote Connectivity Analyzer includes the Teams Sign in connectivity test, which verifies whether a user account satisfies the requirements to sign in to Teams. This supports troubleshooting a Teams sign-in problem.\
\
**Learn more:** [Fix Teams sign-in errors - Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-sign-in/resolve-sign-in-errors) · [Self-help diagnostics for Teams administrators - Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-administration/admin-self-help-diagnostics)

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, you select **Service health**.  
  
Does this achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Service health shows the operational status of Microsoft services, whereas the Teams Sign-in self-help diagnostic is run through Help & Support in the Microsoft 365 admin center and checks whether a user can sign in to the Teams app.\
\
**Learn more:** [Self-help diagnostics for Teams administrators](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-administration/admin-self-help-diagnostics) · [How to check Microsoft 365 service health](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/enterprise/view-service-health?view=o365-worldwide)

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
Solution: In the Microsoft Teams admin center, you select **Teams advisor**.  
  
Does this accomplish the goal?
questions.explanation:
Teams Advisor provides planning and deployment guidance rather than diagnostics for an individual user’s sign-in problem. The Teams Sign-in self-help diagnostic is run from the Microsoft 365 admin center and checks whether a user can sign in to the Teams app.\
\
**Learn more:** [Self-help diagnostics for Teams administrators](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-administration/admin-self-help-diagnostics) · [Resolve sign-in errors in Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/troubleshoot/microsoftteams/teams-sign-in/resolve-sign-in-errors)

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
Your company uses Teams.  
  
You are assigned the Teams Communications Support Specialist role.  
  
You need to be assigned a role that will enable you to publish a new app to the Teams apps page. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege.  
  
Which role should be assigned to you?
questions.explanation: To publish apps to the Teams apps page, you need the Teams Administrator role, which grants the necessary permissions in the Teams Admin Center. The principle of least privilege is followed by assigning only this Teams-specific role. Cloud Application Administrator cannot access Teams Admin Center with the required privileges to manage app publishing.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
Your company uses Teams.  
  
You are assigned the Teams Communications Support Specialist role.  
  
You need to be assigned a role that will enable you to publish a new app to the Teams apps page. The solution must follow the principle of least privilege.  
  
Which role should be assigned to you?
questions.explanation:
Enabling cross-tenant shared-channel collaboration with Fabrikam begins with adding Fabrikam as an organization in Microsoft Entra cross-tenant access settings, then configuring inbound access so Fabrikam's users can be invited into channels hosted by Wingtip Toys. Because B2B direct connect access is disabled by default for a newly added organization, leaving outbound access unconfigured keeps Wingtip Toys users from joining Fabrikam-hosted channels without any extra step.

**Learn more:** [Shared channels in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/shared-channels)

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365 that includes Phone System. All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

All users use Microsoft Teams for collaboration.  

A user reports that he is unable to make phone calls from his Microsoft Teams client. The user reports he is unable to access the dial pad in Microsoft Teams.  

Other users are able to make calls from Microsoft Teams.  

You verify that the user has a license for Phone System.  

You need to enable the user to make calls from Microsoft Teams.  

Which of the following actions should you perform?

options.text: Configure a SIP address for the user.
Enable the user's account for Enterprise Voice.
Assign a Configuration Profile to the user.

questions.explanation: Enterprise Voice must be enabled on the user's account to access the dial pad and make phone calls in Teams. Despite having a Phone System license, users cannot make calls until an administrator explicitly provisions their account for Enterprise Voice.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft 365 subscription.  

The company's global app permission policy is configured as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783720142978-iiuwcp9j.jpg)  
  
Users report that they can view the list of available third-party apps from the Microsoft Teams client.  

You need to ensure that the Who app is the only visible app from the Microsoft Teams client.  

What should you modify?
questions.explanation:
The exhibit already shows the global app permission policy correctly restricting third-party apps to only the Who app, yet users still see other apps listed — because app permission policies control which apps a user can install and interact with, not which apps appear pinned in the app bar. The app setup policy is the setting that determines which apps are pinned and visible in the Teams client's app bar, so it must be edited to remove all pinned apps except Who.

**Learn more:** [Manage app setup policies in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-app-setup-policies)

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365 and all users have a Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

The company network includes Windows Server 2019 servers that host a Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI).  

All company users use the Microsoft Teams desktop client in non-persistent virtual desktops.  

Microsoft has released an update to the Microsoft Teams client that includes several new features.  

You need to ensure that all virtual desktop users are able to use the updated Microsoft Teams clients.  

Which of the following actions should you perform?

options.text: Configure the Teams Upgrade Policy with the Upgrade to Teams setting.
Uninstall the Microsoft Teams MSI package from the VM image and install the latest version.
Configure a Group Policy Object to deploy the latest version of the Microsoft Teams client.
Configure Windows Updates on the servers hosting the VDI.

questions.explanation: In non-persistent VDI environments, Teams must be deployed using per-machine installation with automatic updates disabled. To update Teams in this configuration, you must uninstall the current version from the VM golden image and then install the latest version before users receive new virtual desktops. Group Policy and Windows Updates do not manage Teams client updates in VDI scenarios.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
When you attempt to create a new sensitivity label for Teams, you discover that the Groups & sites option is unavailable as shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783721128833-r4udrv84.png)  
  
You need to be able to select Groups & sites when you create the sensitivity label.  
  
Which cmdlet should you run?
questions.explanation: To enable the 'Groups & sites' option for sensitivity labels in Microsoft 365, you must run the Set-AzureADDirectorySetting cmdlet to enable group-level sensitivity label functionality in Azure AD. This directory setting controls whether sensitivity labels can be applied to Microsoft 365 groups and Teams, making them available in the sensitivity label creation interface. (Note: This cmdlet is now deprecated in favor of Update-MgBetaDirectorySetting in newer environments.)

You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has recently purchased a subscription to Microsoft 365. All users in the company have a  

Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

All users in the company use Microsoft Teams for collaboration.  

The company has a large Sales department. A distribution group named Sales contains all the user accounts of the users in the Sales department.  

You need to create a team in Microsoft Teams for the Sales department users. You want to minimize administrative effort by creating the Team from the Sales group.  

What should you do first?

options.text: Configure a membership rule for the group.
Convert the group to a universal security group.
Convert the group to a global security group.
Convert the group to an Office 365 group.

questions.explanation: To create a Teams from an existing distribution list with minimal administrative effort, the distribution list must first be converted to an Office 365 group (also called Microsoft 365 group). Once converted, a Team can be created directly from the Office 365 group, which automatically inherits the membership. Security group types do not support Teams creation, and membership rules apply to dynamic groups.

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. There is a Microsoft Teams team called Sales that has been configured with Private privacy.  
  
Users are reporting that they can still see the Sales team listed among the suggested teams.  
  
You need to remove the team from the suggested teams list.  
  
What should you do from the Microsoft Teams client?
questions.explanation:
A private team includes a separate 'Team discovery' setting (found under Manage team > Settings > Team discovery) that determines whether the team is offered as a suggestion in the Join a team / suggested teams list and in gallery search results, independent of its Public/Private privacy classification. Clearing the 'Turn on discoverability' option for the team removes it from the suggested teams list and from search results while keeping the team private, so only members explicitly added by an owner can access it. The team's privacy setting only controls whether membership requires owner approval, the 'Hide team' option only hides a team from an individual user's own team list without affecting its visibility to others, and member permissions control in-channel capabilities rather than directory/search visibility — none of these address suggested-teams visibility the way the Team discovery setting does.

**Learn more:** [Manage the Discovery of Private Teams – Ben Talks Teams](https://benando365.home.blog/2019/05/02/manage-the-discovery-of-private-teams/) · [Allow users to search for private teams - Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/search-private-teams)

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Teams deployment.  
  
You need to run various reports to gain insight into how your organization uses Teams.  
  
Which two reports require a Teams Premium license? Each correct answer presents a complete solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Teams with the most external user and guest activity

questions.explanation:
Teams Premium provides premium webinar capabilities and advanced Virtual Appointments analytics. The Advanced Virtual Appointments activity report specifically reports usage of premium capabilities such as SMS notifications, on-demand appointments, and queue usage.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Teams Advanced Virtual Appointments activity report](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/frontline/advanced-virtual-appointments-activity-report?view=o365-worldwide) · [Overview of Microsoft Teams Premium](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/overview-of-microsoft-teams-premium-4b34cd18-fa16-4797-bae0-b96b13a54f52)

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams.  

You plan to deploy Microsoft Teams voice.  

Which two settings require a resource account? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  

NOTE: Each correct selection worth one point.
questions.explanation: Resource accounts are required for both Auto Attendants and Call Queues in Teams phone system deployments. Resource accounts serve as the identity for these entities and enable assigning phone numbers to them. Resource accounts are not required for Call Park policies, Emergency policies, or Guest access settings, which have different configuration mechanisms.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams.  

When a user creates a new team, the user sees the templates shown in the following exhibit.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783720977855-f01azkt9.png)  
  
You need to ensure that the user sees only the Manage a Project template.  

What should you do?

options.text: From the Microsoft Teams admin center, modify the team templates.
From PowerShell, modify the team templates.
From the Microsoft Teams admin center, modify the templates policies.
From PowerShell, modify the Teams policies.

questions.explanation: Teams template policies control which templates are available and visible to users when creating new teams. By modifying template policies in the Microsoft Teams admin center, administrators can restrict users to see only specific templates like 'Manage a Project'. This provides fine-grained control over team creation workflows without modifying the templates themselves.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company uses Teams.  
  
Users often use Teams mobile apps to make and receive calls.  
  
You change the display name for a user named User1.  
  
User1 reports that their previous name still appears when they receive incoming calls in the Teams mobile app.  
  
You need to ensure that the updated display name for User1 appears.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Collect and review the Debug logs.
From the Microsoft 365 admin center, run self-help diagnostics.
Clear the Microsoft Teams client cache on the mobile phone.

questions.explanation: The Teams mobile app caches contact and profile information locally, so after a display name change it will keep showing the stale cached name on incoming call screens until the cache is cleared and the client refetches directory data. Reviewing debug logs, running Sync-CsOnlineApplicationInstance, or running Microsoft 365 self-help diagnostics do not clear the client-side cache causing the stale name display.

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft 365 subscription and has deployed Microsoft Teams for 5,000 users.  
  
You need to generate a report that contains the following information:  
  
- The number of active Microsoft Teams users during the last seven days.  
- The number of active team channels during the last seven days.  
  
Which usage reports should you run?
questions.explanation:
The Teams usage report in the Microsoft Teams admin center (Analytics & reports) provides organization-wide summary statistics, including the number of active users and active channels over a selected reporting period (7, 30, 90, or 180 days). This distinguishes it from the Teams user activity report, which focuses on per-user activity metrics (such as messages, calls, and meetings) rather than channel-level activity counts, and from the device usage and live event usage reports, which report on different metrics entirely.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Teams usage report - Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-analytics-and-reports/teams-usage-report)

You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has departments named Sales, Accounts, Research and Production.  

The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365. All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E5 license.  

You have configured a Team for each of the departments.  

Currently, users in any department can use Microsoft Teams to communicate with users from any other department.  

You need to configure the environment to ensure that users in the Research team can only communicate with other users in the Research team by using Microsoft  

Teams.  

What should you do?
questions.explanation: Information Barrier policies restrict communication between defined user segments based on attributes like department. This ensures Research team members can only communicate with other Research team members, preventing unauthorized cross-department collaboration. Meeting policies, App Protection policies, and Conference Bridges do not provide user-level communication segmentation.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. The company's main office is in Chicago, and it has just opened a new office in Toronto with 500 users.  
  
You need to make sure the correct address is available to emergency responders.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a configuration profile and assign the profile to the device of each user.
Add an emergency address, and then modify the location for each phone number.
Add an emergency address, and then modify the outbound calling setting for each user.
Create a calling policy and assign the policy to each user.

questions.explanation:
Microsoft Teams Dynamic Emergency Calling requires that an emergency address (a civic address) be created for each physical location, and then that address be associated with the phone numbers assigned to users at that location. This is done in the Teams admin center under Locations > Emergency addresses, followed by assigning that address to the relevant phone numbers (Voice > Phone numbers > Emergency address). When a user places an emergency call, Teams uses the location tied to their phone number to relay the correct civic address to the emergency services provider and dispatcher, ensuring responders are sent to the correct site (in this case, the new Toronto office rather than the Chicago headquarters).

**Learn more:** [Manage emergency addresses and locations in Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/what-are-emergency-locations-addresses) · [Configure dynamic emergency calling for Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/configure-dynamic-emergency-calling)

Office 365 Groups expiration policy is configured with a 180-day lifetime, expiration enabled only for selected groups (Team1), and a no-owner contact email of user2@contoso.com. Because User3 created Team1, User3 is automatically an owner of the group. Renewal notifications under this policy are sent only to group owners, and they are sent 30, 15, and 1 days before the expiration date - never 180 days before. The 'email contact for groups with no owners' setting only takes effect if a group has no owners at all, which does not apply to Team1 since User3 is an owner. Renewing a group before expiration can only be performed by an owner (or a Global/Groups Administrator); User2, who holds only the Teams Communications Administrator role and is not an owner of Team1, cannot renew it. Therefore User1 will not get a notification 180 days out, User2 cannot renew Team1, and User3 (the owner) will receive the standard 30-day renewal notification.

Your organization has a Microsoft Office 365 subscription. Currently, all users are able to create private channels in Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to prevent certain specific users from being able to create private channels.  
  
What should you create from the Microsoft Teams admin center?
questions.explanation:
Private channel creation is governed by Teams policies in the Microsoft Teams admin center. Under Teams > Teams policies, you can create a custom policy and set the 'Create private channels' option to Off, then assign that policy to the specific users who should be restricted, leaving the global policy (which allows private channel creation) applied to everyone else. Meeting policies, setup policies, and permission policies do not include controls for channel creation.

**Learn more:** [Manage Teams policies in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/teams-policies)

You need to configure the environment so that it meets the device requirements for the Microsoft Teams phones.  
  
What should you do from the Microsoft Teams admin center?
questions.explanation:
Configuration profiles in the Microsoft Teams admin center (under Teams Devices) are specifically designed to manage settings on Teams phone devices, such as IP phones, allowing administrators to control device-level requirements (e.g., display, network, security settings) and apply them to a device or group of devices. Meeting policies and calling policies govern user calling/meeting behavior, not device hardware configuration, making configuration profiles the correct tool for meeting Teams phone device requirements.

**Learn more:** [Manage Microsoft Teams Phone devices - Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/devices/manage-teams-phone-devices) · [Configuration profiles for Teams devices](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/devices/config-profiles)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You work as a Systems Administrator for your company. The company has a subscription to Microsoft 365. All users in your company have a Microsoft 365 E3 license.  

All users use Microsoft Teams for collaboration.  

A company security policy has the following requirements:  

✑ All users except Team owners must be prevented from deleting sent messages  

✑ Team owners must be able to delete sent messages  

✑ All users must be prevented from editing sent messages  

You need to configure Microsoft Teams to meet the security requirements. The solution must minimize the number of policies configured.  

What should you configure?

options.text: The default Messaging policy and one additional Messaging policy.
The default Messaging policy and two additional Messaging policies.
The default Messaging policy and the default Meeting policy.

questions.explanation:
A single Teams messaging policy exposes independent controls for "Owners can delete sent messages," "Delete sent messages" (for regular members), and "Edit sent messages." Setting the first to on, the second to off, and the third to off in the default Global messaging policy satisfies all three requirements simultaneously without needing any additional policy.

**Learn more:** [Messaging policies in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/messaging-policies-in-teams)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription.  
  
You need to deploy video conferencing equipment to meeting rooms. The solution must meet the following requirements:  
  
• Meet the device compliance requirements specified in Microsoft Intune.  

• Support Intelligent Speaker.  

• Support Operator Connect.  

• Minimize costs.  
  
Which type of license should you assign to each phone?
questions.explanation:
Teams Rooms Pro is the license tier that includes intelligent speaker recognition, Intune-based device compliance and remote management, and Teams Phone connectivity for Operator Connect calling; Teams Rooms Basic omits these advanced management and calling capabilities, so it cannot satisfy every requirement even though it costs less. Assigning general Microsoft 365 E3 or E5 licenses to room hardware is not the supported licensing model for Teams Rooms devices.

**Learn more:** [Microsoft Teams Rooms licenses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization has a Microsoft 365 subscription. You are planning to let users reserve several of the company's conference rooms directly from the Microsoft Teams client when scheduling meetings.  
  
You need to create the necessary resources in Microsoft 365 to support this.  
  
What should you create for each conference room?
questions.explanation:
To make a physical space bookable as a meeting location in Outlook/Teams, you create a resource mailbox of the room type (a room mailbox) for each conference room in Exchange Online (via the Exchange admin center or New-Mailbox -Room in PowerShell). This gives the room its own calendar so it can be added to a meeting invite and automatically accept or decline bookings based on availability, letting users search for and reserve it when scheduling meetings in Teams.

**Learn more:** [Create and manage room mailboxes - Exchange Online | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/recipients-in-exchange-online/manage-resource-mailboxes)

questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams. All users are assigned an Microsoft 365 E3 license.  
  
You need to ensure that the users can join scheduled meetings by dialing a toll-free phone number.  
  
Which two add-on licenses should you assign to the users? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation: To enable toll-free dial-in to Teams meetings for E3 users, purchase both Microsoft 365 Audio Conferencing (provides dial-in phone numbers and meeting bridge) and Communication Credits (required to pay toll-free per-minute charges). Together these enable the complete toll-free meeting dial-in capability.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
Your company uses a license that includes 60 minutes of dial-out for Teams meetings.  
  
You need to review the total costs of each meeting organizer for dial-out calls during meetings.  
  
Which report should you review?

options.text: the Microsoft Call Quality Dashboard detailed report
the Microsoft Call Quality Dashboard summary report

questions.explanation: The Audio Conferencing dial-out usage report specifically tracks dial-out minutes consumed by meeting organizers. This report provides per-organizer cost analysis for dial-out calls, which is exactly what the question requires. Other reports focus on different metrics like PSTN minutes or call quality.

questions.question:
Your on-premises network contains a main site and a branch site.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
You need to use Network planner to identify the networking requirements between the sites.  
  
From Network planner, you create a new network plan.  
  
What should you do next?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft's documented Network Planner workflow proceeds: create a network plan, add personas, add sites to the plan, generate a report, then analyze the output. Personas define the calling/meeting profiles used to estimate bandwidth per site, so they must exist before sites and the report can produce meaningful network requirement estimates.\
\
**Learn more:** [Tutorial: Network Planner](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/tutorial-network-planner-example)

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
Your on-premises network contains a main site and a branch site.  
  
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
You need to use Network planner to identify the networking requirements between the sites.  
  
From Network planner, you create a new network plan.  
  
What should you do next?
questions.explanation:
Chat message deletion behavior in Microsoft Teams is governed by messaging policies, which include a setting that controls whether users can delete sent messages. Because the restriction must apply only to the research department rather than the entire organization, an admin cannot simply edit the global (org-wide default) messaging policy, since that would impact every user. Instead, the correct approach is to create a new custom messaging policy with the appropriate delete setting configured, and then assign that policy to the research department's users or group. This allows granular control so only the targeted department is restricted from deleting chat messages, while other users remain unaffected.

**Learn more:** [Messaging policies in Teams - Microsoft Teams | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/messaging-policies-in-teams)

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
In Microsoft Teams, you create a new private team named Team1 and add a user named User1 as a member.  
  
User1 attempts to add members to Team1 and reports that approval is required.  
  
You need to ensure that User1 can add members to Team 1 without requiring approval.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure a new Microsoft Teams policy.
Configure User1 as an owner of Team1.
Assign the Teams Communications Support Specialist role to User1.

questions.explanation: In private Teams, regular members must request approval to invite new members; only team owners can add members without approval. Configuring User1 as an owner of Team1 grants the necessary permissions to add members directly without requiring team owner approval, bypassing the approval workflow while maintaining team governance.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
You have a Teams deployment.  
  
You start a meeting and enable the following settings:  
  
• Enable Green room  

• Provide CART Captions  

• Enable end-to-end Encryption  

• Anonymous users can join the meeting  
  
What feature is no longer available during the meeting?

options.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams meetings and events

questions.explanation: When end-to-end encryption is enabled in Teams meetings and calls, Microsoft 365 Copilot becomes unavailable because Copilot requires access to meeting transcripts and recordings for analysis. End-to-end encryption disables transcription, which eliminates Copilot's ability to function.

questions.domain: Monitor, report on, and troubleshoot Teams
questions.question:
You have a Teams deployment.  
  
You start a meeting and enable the following settings:  
  
• Enable Green room  

• Provide CART Captions  

• Enable end-to-end Encryption  

• Anonymous users can join the meeting  
  
What feature is no longer available during the meeting?
questions.explanation: The coexistence mode 'SfBWithTeamsCollab' allows Skype for Business users to use their client for chats and calls while Teams handles collaboration features. This mode preserves the Skype for Business calling experience during migration while introducing Teams collaboration capabilities.

questions.domain: Configure and manage a Teams environment
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has five offices, and each office has its own unique phone number. You are planning to deploy Phone System to all five offices.  
  
You need to make sure that each office has:  
  
- A unique greeting message for weekdays  
- A unique greeting message for weekends  
  
The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: one auto attendant that contains all five phone numbers
one call queue that contains all five phone numbers
five auto attendants that each contains one phone number
five call queues that each contains one phone number

questions.explanation:
Auto attendants in Microsoft Teams Phone System allow you to configure distinct business hours (weekday) and after-hours (weekend) greetings, and each auto attendant is linked to a single phone number via its resource account. Because each office needs a unique phone number as well as unique weekday and weekend greetings, each office must have its own dedicated auto attendant — a single auto attendant covering all five numbers could not provide five separate greeting sets. Call queues do not offer a weekday/weekend greeting distinction, so they are not suitable for this requirement.

**Learn more:** [Plan for auto attendants and call queues - Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/plan-auto-attendant-call-queue) · [Create a resource account for auto attendants](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/create-a-resource-account)

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
You plan to deploy Microsoft Teams to a remote location.  

You perform a network readiness assessment for Microsoft Teams by using the Network Testing Companion.  

Which two tests are included in the assessment? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation: The Network Testing Companion's assessment checks whether the required Teams media ports/protocols are open and reachable (open and blocked ports) and runs a synthetic call to measure audio quality metrics such as jitter, latency, and packet loss. It does not include a genuine video quality test or a full QoS marking validation — those are outside the scope of this lightweight companion tool.

questions.domain: Manage teams, channels, chats, and apps
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Teams.  
  
Your company requires that all inactive teams be deleted.  
  
You need to identify teams that were inactive during the last 90 days.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation: The Teams usage report displays team activity data including the last activity date. This report allows administrators to filter and identify teams with no activity during the last 90 days, enabling identification of inactive teams for deletion or archival per organizational policy.

questions.domain: Manage meetings and calling
questions.question:
You have a Microsoft 365 E3 subscription that uses Microsoft Teams.  
  
You plan to deploy 20 conference phones that will support Direct Routing and one-touch join for Teams calendar meetings.  
  
Which type of license do you require for each phone?
questions.explanation:
One-touch join for scheduled calendar meetings is a Microsoft Teams Rooms capability and is not supported on the Common Area Phone / Teams Shared Devices license, which covers only basic calling and Direct Routing. Achieving Direct Routing together with one-touch meeting join for dedicated conference room phones requires a Teams Rooms license (Standard), which bundles Phone System, meeting join, and calendar integration.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Teams Rooms licenses](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-licensing)
